findings.rationale: The attempt counter type is generated as an exclusive range 0..max_attempts via effect.retry.max_attempts.unwrap_or(1). With the default (max_attempts is None) the range is 0..1, which permits only 0, yet the command request path writes attempts[correlation] = 1. The retry action writes attempts[correlation] = attempts[correlation] + 1 guarded only by attempts < max_attempts, so the increment can reach max_attempts, which is outside the exclusive range 0..max_attempts. The declared range is off by one and should be 0..=max_attempts or 0..(max_attempts + 1).

The generated compensation action saga_{saga}_compensate_{trigger}_after_{after} guards only on the trigger_event flag (Context::event_flag of compensation.trigger_event), but after_event is added to the observed set and gets an observe action that sets its event flag, which is never used as a guard. The compensation can therefore fire before after_event has occurred, breaking the intended ordering; the guard should also require the after_event flag.
